mechanism: Isoniazid may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing escitalopram plasma concentrations and serotonergic effects; both agents can cause CNS effects and peripheral neuropathy.
action: Monitor for increased escitalopram adverse effects (QT prolongation, serotonin syndrome symptoms, CNS effects); consider ECG monitoring given escitalopram's dose-dependent QT prolongation risk; adjust escitalopram dose if needed.
